## Direct answers
- **Where is Lone Mountain Heights?** Northwest Las Vegas along the Lone Mountain corridor, west of I-215, with foothill views and access to Summerlin and Centennial Hills.
- **How do I tour?** Book Calendly on this site or call (702) 222-1964. Buyer representation is through Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties.
- **How do I search listings?** Use the live RealScout MLS search on the homepage for current inventory.
- **Out-of-state buyers?** Yes—Dr. Jan Duffy helps California and other relocators compare Northwest Las Vegas communities and schedule tours.

## Area
Lone Mountain Heights is a Northwest Las Vegas residential neighborhood (primarily single-family homes). Clark County School District serves the area. Market prices change with inventory—use MLS search or call for street-level comps.
